name: MultiReQA
description: We are creating a challenging new benchmark MultiReQA: A Cross-Domain Evaluation for Retrieval Question Answering Models. Retrieval question answering (ReQA) is the task of retrieving a sentence-level answer to a question from an open corpus. MultiReQA is a new multi-domain ReQA evaluation suite composed of eight retrieval QA tasks drawn from publicly available QA datasets from the MRQA shared task.
